Principle.name: OpenAPI Specification Compliance
Principle.description: Validates that the API specification follows OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 standards and best practices
checks: Required info fields (title, version) are present

Principle.name: API Documentation Quality
Principle.description: Ensures comprehensive and high-quality API documentation including descriptions, examples, and usage guidelines

principles.Message: API documentation is comprehensive and high quality

Principle.name: Error Handling Standards
Principle.description: Validates comprehensive error response documentation and consistent error handling patterns
checks: Error responses include error details schema
Common error responses are defined in components

messages.Common error responses are defined in co: No common error responses defined in components

principles.SuggestedFix: Add comprehensive error response documentation including codes, messages, and consistent error schemas

Principle.name: Request Schema Definitions
Principle.description: Ensures all API requests have comprehensive schema definitions with proper data types, validation rules, and constraints
checks: All request bodies have content schemas
All numeric fields have min/max values
All string fields have length constraints

principles.Message: All requests have comprehensive schema definitions with proper validation rules

Principle.name: Security Standards
Principle.description: Validates comprehensive security requirements and authentication mechanisms

principles.Message: All security requirements are properly defined and consistent

Principle.name: API Versioning Strategy
Principle.description: Validates proper API versioning implementation and documentation

principles.Message: API versioning strategy is properly documented
